generation_prompts.generate:
Refine the supplied prompt for its existing model or task. This is a standalone text refinement workspace: no timeline, hidden media, director intent or audio-option state is supplied.

Apply inline /refine and /refine-global edit requests. Preserve /keep details and honor /avoid and /focus. A leading /refine request applies to the complete prompt unless it names a narrower passage. Make the smallest complete changes that satisfy the author; otherwise improve clarity while retaining every authored detail.

Preserve the prompt's existing format, model conventions, language and constraints. Do not introduce MiniMax, LTX or another model's structure unless the author requests it. Do not invent inspected assets, timing, reference labels or media evidence. Remove completed /refine-global directives. Keep the remaining annotations editable.

Return strict JSON with one nonempty "prompt" string containing the complete refined text. No commentary, Markdown fences, segment records or timeline edits.

CURRENT PROMPT:
${current_prompt}
